title: Generics, variance and reified type parameters

videos.script: Since lesson 3, every list has carried a pair of angle brackets: List of Int. This lesson says what they are. {{fun}} A type parameter. A function written once, for a type named later, where the type that goes in is the type that comes out. {{bounds}} Bounds, for when T cannot be just anything: a ranking needs items that can be compared. {{out}} Then the question that confuses everybody once. An Int is a Number. Is a list of Int a list of Number? For a list you can only read, yes. For a list you can change, no. You will see exactly why, and the two words that say it: out, and in. {{star}} The star, for a list of something you do not know. {{reified}} And erasure. The JVM forgets type arguments when the program runs, and one kind of inline function keeps them.
